links.comparator_used: Vendor default operating threshold of 0.15 versus a locally customised threshold of 0.10 on local primary care CXR data
links.outcome: Sensitivity and negative predictive value for a safety-focused AI co-triage workflow
links.tradeoff: Specificity was 71.7% (95% CI 67.3% to 76.1%) at the lower threshold, which the authors judged acceptable for minimising false negatives. The abstract gives no specificity at the default threshold and does not report the change in operational improvement.
links.quote: Lowering the threshold to 0.10 increased sensitivity to 93.2% (95% CI 90.7% to 95.5%) and NPV to 91.3% (95% CI 88.2% to 94.3%), with specificity of 71.7% (95% CI 67.3% to 76.1%).
